fields.statement: At 318b2ef1, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(roadmap|describe-golden|inbox|health)' passes, including the new roadmap-projects.txtar: with a root of two projects (alpha with a milestone, beta with a backlog change set), rhiza roadmap --json at the root gives alpha's milestone group and beta's backlog group, each group and change set tagged with its project; --project alpha/beta and running from inside alpha give only that project's part, with no project tags; --project nope fails with 'not registered'. By hand with a scratch build and a fresh two-project root, the human roadmap shows '## alpha: ma' and '## beta: Backlog', and --limit 1 paging continues from alpha onto beta's backlog, ending with next_cursor null. go test ./internal/api -run 'Roadmap|Health|Milestone|Plan|Inbox' passes. The usage/limit tests in internal/api pass at this commit in a clean worktree; they failed only inside the verifier checkout, and also fail there on code this diff does not touch. Read the diff: health and the web milestones view keep a local-only roadmap; cursors carry the project.
